picks.name: Dak Prescott
picks.note: ARI is 31st in dropback EPA and 30th in schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs; 21.1 XFPPG is one of the highest on the slate; Lamb and Pickens have a combined 50% target share and 71% air yards share; could approach 20% ownership

picks.name: Josh Allen
picks.note: At least 18 fantasy points in every game and 34+ in 3 of them; rarely above 10% ownership; shootout potential with Lamar expected back; BAL is 10th-most schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs

picks.name: Jacoby Brissett
picks.note: One of the best sets of weapons for a QB; DAL is 30th in dropback EPA and 26th vs. QBs; 6.5-pt road underdogs could mean 40+ dropbacks; stack with Wilson/McBride

picks.name: Kyler Murray
picks.note: Finally on board; MIN hasn't been pushed yet but 3.5-pt road underdogs at DET should change that; DET has allowed the most QB points; 21 rush attempts in the last 3 games; stack with Jefferson

picks.name: Trevor Lawrence
picks.note: Off the bye vs. IND (20th in dropback EPA, 21st vs. QBs); 8.5-pt home favorites with one of the highest team totals; 20+ points in 4 of 6 games

picks.name: Geno Smith
picks.note: Boom-or-bust: under 16 points in 5 games, 24+ in the other 2; LVR plays fast and has a bottom-10 pass defense, so this looks like a boom spot

picks.name: Chase Brown
picks.note: 71% snap share and his best game script to date as 10.5-pt home favorites; TEN is 24th in run EPA and 29th in schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs; stack with CIN D/ST

picks.name: Bhayshul Tuten
picks.note: Touch counts of 16, 24 and 19 in the last 3 games; 43% of carries inside the 5 and a route on 41% of dropbacks; IND is 27th in run EPA and 27th vs. RBs

picks.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
picks.note: Brutal matchup (MIN is 1st in run EPA and 1st vs. RBs), but low ownership would make him the top tournament play; 20+ touches and all the high-value touches as home favorites

picks.name: Bijan Robinson
picks.note: Elite workload with more systemic risk in the offense; TBB is 5th in run EPA and 3rd vs. RBs; heavy passing game role and dominates inside-the-5 touches; tournament exception

picks.name: Javonte Williams
picks.note: 30.5 team total as a large home favorite; 9 touchdowns in 7 games; path to 20+ touches; ARI is tougher vs. the run than the pass

picks.name: Kenneth Walker III
picks.note: Tough matchup in a low-total division game, but DEN is better vs. the pass than the run; clear path to 20+ touches and shouldn't be very popular

picks.name: Kyren Williams
picks.note: Shying away from him because of Corum, but he has 16+ touches in each of the last 5 games; sizable favorites vs. LAC

picks.name: Bucky Irving
picks.note: Coming off a huge game; ATL has allowed the 7th-most RB points with lots of catches and touchdowns; boom-or-bust, large-field tournaments only

picks.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
picks.note: Feature back in one of the best matchups on the board vs. MIA; positive game scripts mean teams run early and often; about 15 touches expected

picks.name: Puka Nacua
picks.note: 32% target share and 41% air yards share, and even more with Adams out; LAC is 20th in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs; should be one of the most popular players

picks.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
picks.note: Toughest matchup to date vs. MIN, but a blitz-heavy defense means quick throws and 12-14 target upside; no TDs in the last 3 games after 5 in the first 4

picks.name: CeeDee Lamb
picks.note: 29% target share and 40% air yards share; ARI may have the worst secondary in football; slight preference over Pickens (21% / 31%) but plan to have both

picks.name: Justin Jefferson
picks.note: Slow start tied to conservative game scripts; MIN finally gets pushed as road underdogs vs. DET, who are 30th in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs; breakout spot

picks.name: Zay Flowers
picks.note: 30% target share and 32% air yards share; Lamar back means an aggressive offense vs. BUF; no team has allowed more WR points than the Bills

picks.name: Michael Wilson
picks.note: Nearly a Core Play; 22% target share and 36% air yards share; 6.5-pt underdogs in a dome vs. a bottom-3 pass defense; want at least one of Wilson and McBride in every lineup

picks.name: Ja'Marr Chase
picks.note: Big outing possible if CIN stays aggressive when up 10+; TEN has allowed the 2nd-most schedule-adjusted points to WRs; slightly prefer the running game

picks.name: Tee Higgins
picks.note: Same Burrow/CIN upside if the Bengals throw when ahead; TEN has allowed the 2nd-most schedule-adjusted points to WRs

picks.name: Garrett Wilson
picks.note: Under 10 points in 3 of the last 4, so under 10% projected ownership; 25+ points in 2 games this season; LVR plays fast and is 9th-most schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs

picks.name: Parker Washington
picks.note: 24% target share and 39% air yards share, 4 TDs in 6 games; overlooked this week; IND has struggled to defend slot receivers

picks.name: Trey McBride
picks.note: Essentially a WR1 at tight end; 27% target share and 23% air yards share; DAL is 30th in dropback EPA; ARI underdogs create a great game script

picks.name: Brenton Strange
picks.note: 18% target share and 17% air yards share; IND has long struggled to defend tight ends; affordable on both sites

picks.name: Travis Kelce
picks.note: 18% target share and 21% air yards share; DEN is tough on WRs (Surtain back) but has allowed the 10th-most points to TEs

picks.name: Steelers
picks.note: 9 turnovers generated already; facing Watson, who has taken more sacks than any QB; CLE is 5-2 but has a negative point differential

picks.name: Bengals
picks.note: 10.5-pt home favorites vs. TEN, who have 8 turnovers and one of the worst passing attacks; sacks and turnovers likely if CIN builds a lead; stack with Brown

picks.name: Lions
picks.note: Salary saver; boom if the offense builds a lead at home and forces MIN to air it out; pairs with Gibbs
